title: Use CSV template
purpose: Download issued results with the column headings and order your recipient needs.
summary: Choose columns and headings for a CSV or Excel workbook from one issued report version. Keep your template on your computer to reuse it for another download.

tasks.title: Download results with your template
steps: Check the report number and version at the top of the page.
Choose your saved file under [[CSV template]].
Under [[Download format]], choose CSV or Excel (.xlsx).

tasks.title: Make a reusable template
steps: Change the headings in row one. Keep each heading above the corresponding field key in row two.
Move or delete whole columns to match the recipient’s layout.
Save the two rows as a UTF-8, comma-delimited CSV.

good_to_know: A superseded version contains the results issued at that time. Open the latest version from the report when you need current results.
Keep units, qualifiers and reporting limits when the recipient needs them to interpret a result. Include the report number and version to identify the issue after combining files.
The same CSV template works for both formats. Keep a local copy to reuse it.
The stored PDF remains the report of record.

items.label: Current version / Superseded version
items.description: Identifies the selected issue and shows whether a later version has been released. Only an active client account can open an issued version of its own report.

items.label: Report number / Version
items.description: Identifies the issue supplying the result rows. The filename carries both identifiers even if the template omits their columns.

items.label: Download example template
items.description: Download a reusable file with a heading and field key for each supported result column. Row one supplies the output headings. Row two selects the fields in the same order.

items.label: CSV template
items.description: Choose a UTF-8, comma-delimited file of at most 16 KiB. Use exactly two rows of equal width with at least one column. Keep the field keys exactly as shown in the example. Headings and keys must be nonempty and unique. Use plain text headings without control characters or spreadsheet formula prefixes.

items.label: Download format
items.description: CSV is the default. Excel (.xlsx) creates a workbook with one Results sheet. It stores identifiers, values and timestamps as text so leading zeros, trailing zeros and time zone offsets are preserved.

items.label: Download results
items.description: Download one row per issued result, using the stored result text, units and qualifiers for the fields you selected. Unavailable values stay blank. The portal shows template errors at the field. Correct your saved file, select it again and retry. If Excel cannot preserve the selected text or the data exceed a worksheet limit, choose CSV and reselect your template to download all the data.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Close the form and return to the report. If you choose a file and cancel before downloading, the dialog asks whether to discard the selection.
